sections.heading: Overview
bullets: A maze traverse, not a fight — navigate the shifting castle to reach Xera while managing a stacking madness effect.

sections.heading: Madness stacks
bullets: Everyone gains Madness stacks over time (1 every 3s) — and it doubles to 2 every 3s if you're looking at the giant rotating statue in the center of the castle. Don't stare at it.
At 99 stacks you die, no exceptions — use the fountains scattered around the castle to cleanse 10 stacks at a time, or drink from one to pause the buildup briefly.

sections.heading: Haunting Statues
bullets: These chase anyone who isn't looking at them. You can knock, pull, or push them, but you can't damage them — use that to redirect them, not to fight them.
Follow your commander's callouts through the portals and fake floors — it's a scripted path, not something to improvise.
